name: facilio-delivery-studio-handoff
description: Lets Claude open the task, pictures and documents that Delivery Studio hands over, and send the answer back.
long_description: When you choose Open in Claude Desktop in Facilio Delivery Studio, the prompt carries a short-lived hand-off reference. This extension lets Claude read that hand-off (instructions, project context, pictures, PDFs, Word and Excel text) and send its answer back to Delivery Studio for you to check. It has no access to your files, stores no passwords or keys, and only opens the signed links Delivery Studio creates.

tools.name: get_current_task
tools.description: Open the Delivery Studio hand-off and summarise the task

tools.description: Project and module context for the task

tools.name: get_attached_images

tools.description: Send the finished answer back to Delivery Studio
